CONDITIONS TO WATCH需要观察的条件

What changes the view什么会改变判断

01

A stronger path更强的路径

If export strength continues and consumption broadens without renewed inflation, growth could spread beyond the external sector.若出口保持强势，消费扩张且未重新推高通胀，增长有望扩散至对外部门之外。

02

A weaker path更弱的路径

If inflation persists and further rate increases pass through to borrowing costs, households and financing-sensitive firms could face greater pressure.若通胀持续，进一步加息传导至借贷成本，家庭与对融资敏感的企业可能面临更大压力。

WHAT TO WATCH关注重点

Exports, consumption, housing and household credit, and subsequent Bank of Korea decisions.出口、消费、住房与家庭信贷，以及韩国央行后续决策。

THE TRANSMISSION CHANNEL传导渠道

Export demand and domestic financing出口需求与国内融资

Exports and investment support activity in the central bank’s assessment. Higher rates can act on housing and financing-sensitive spending through a different channel.央行研判认为出口与投资支撑经济。较高利率则可能通过另一渠道影响住房及对融资敏感的支出。

Export earnings, the won and domestic financing conditions connect the economy to equities.出口利润、韩元与国内融资条件将经济变化传导至股市。

It uses dated daily quotes over three calendar months, with the last available quote on or before the reference date.汇率变化衡量本币兑美元的价值变化，不含利息收益。正值表示本币升值。计算采用带日期的每日汇率，以三个日历月前的参考日或之前最近一次观测为基准。

CONDITIONS TO WATCH需要观察的条件

What changes the view什么会改变判断

01

A stronger path更强的路径

If orders remain strong and investment spreads beyond leading exporters, domestic activity could broaden despite slower annual GDP growth.若订单持续强劲且投资扩散至龙头出口企业之外，即使全年GDP增速放缓，国内活动仍可能扩大。

02

A weaker path更弱的路径

If a later CBC outlook cuts its own growth forecast because AI orders weaken, the export-support thesis would need revising.若后续台湾央行因AI订单走弱而下调自身增长预测，就需修正出口支撑的判断。

WHAT TO WATCH关注重点

AI export orders, production, capital spending and subsequent CBC growth revisions.AI出口订单、生产、资本支出与台湾央行后续增长预测修订。

THE TRANSMISSION CHANNEL传导渠道

AI demand, investment and financingAI需求、投资与融资

Export orders and capacity investment support activity. Higher funding demand and energy costs can offset part of that support through borrowing costs and margins.出口订单与产能投资支持经济活动；融资需求与能源成本上升可能通过借贷成本及利润率抵消部分支持。

Strong technology demand can support export income while energy and currency costs affect margins.强劲科技需求支持出口收入，能源与汇率成本则影响利润率。

CONDITIONS TO WATCH需要观察的条件

What changes the view什么会改变判断

01

A stronger path更强的路径

If later MPC evidence finds energy pass-through contained while labour conditions stabilise, the case for further restraint would weaken.若后续央行证据显示能源价格传导受控且劳动市场企稳，进一步紧缩的必要性将减弱。

02

A weaker path更弱的路径

If wage and service-price persistence increases while employment weakens, policy would face a more difficult growth–inflation trade-off.若工资与服务价格的持续性增强，同时就业走弱，政策将面临更棘手的增长与通胀权衡。

WHAT TO WATCH关注重点

Private-sector pay, services prices, employment and the next MPC assessment of second-round effects.私营部门工资、服务价格、就业及央行下一次对第二轮效应的评估。

THE TRANSMISSION CHANNEL传导渠道

Energy pass-through versus labour demand能源价格传导与劳动需求

The key tension is whether energy costs spread into wage and service prices before softer employment weakens demand.关键在于能源成本是否会在就业走软削弱需求之前，先传导至工资与服务价格。

Lower financing costs can support domestic demand; sterling also changes overseas earnings translation.融资成本下降可支持内需，英镑也会改变海外利润的换算。

CONDITIONS TO WATCH需要观察的条件

What changes the view什么会改变判断

01

A stronger path更强的路径

Energy relief improves growth and inflation together.能源压力缓解有望同时改善增长与通胀。

02

A weaker path更弱的路径

Persistent energy costs squeeze demand and margins.能源成本持续偏高将挤压需求与利润率。

WHAT TO WATCH关注重点

Energy prices, underlying inflation and credit conditions.能源价格、基础通胀与信贷条件。

Currency change measures the value of the local currency against USD, without interest income. A positive value means appreciation. It uses dated daily quotes over three calendar months, with the last available quote on or before the reference date.汇率变化衡量本币兑美元的价值变化，不含利息收益。正值表示本币升值。计算采用带日期的每日汇率，以三个日历月前的参考日或之前最近一次观测为基准。

Revision figures compare the same provider, measure and target period across identified editions. A difference between forecasters is a separate published view. Annual inflation uses an annual average; monthly inflation observations use year-over-year rates.预测修订比较同一机构、同一指标与同一目标期的不同版本。不同机构的预测另列为独立观点。全年通胀采用年度平均；月度通胀观测采用同比增幅。

Current account经常账户: Euro-area aggregate adjusted for reporting discrepancies in intra-area transactions.欧元区汇总数据已调整区内交易的报告差异。

Government balance政府财政收支: General government. Sector and instrument coverage can differ across countries; this is not a sovereign-risk ranking.政府部门。各经济体的部门与债务工具口径可能不同；这些数据不构成主权风险排名。

Gross government debt政府总债务: General government. Sector and instrument coverage can differ across countries; this is not a sovereign-risk ranking.政府部门。各经济体的部门与债务工具口径可能不同；这些数据不构成主权风险排名。

FOLLOW THE MECHANISM追踪传导机制

Global connections全球关联

Channels to examine, not causal estimates用于研究的渠道，并非因果估计
01 / DEMAND需求

Technology to exports科技传导至出口

Investment demand flows into export orders, production and earnings. Follow whether that strength spreads into domestic activity.投资需求传导至出口订单、生产与利润。关注这股力量能否扩散至国内经济。

Taiwan台湾 ↗South Korea韩国 ↗
02 / PRICES价格

Energy to real incomes能源传导至实际收入

Higher import costs can squeeze households and margins. Inflation then changes the room available for monetary support.进口成本上升可能挤压家庭购买力与利润率。通胀继而改变货币政策的支持空间。

Japan日本 ↗India印度 ↗Euro Area欧元区 ↗
03 / FINANCING融资

Policy to spending政策传导至支出

Policy reaches the economy through borrowing, saving and exchange rates. A lower rate is useful only if transmission follows.政策通过借贷、储蓄与汇率影响经济。利率下降的作用，取决于后续传导。

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币
  • Debt currency债务货币
  • Hedges对冲
  • Effective date生效日期
Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Fast pressure. Slow resilience.短期压力，长期韧性

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币

  • Effective date生效日期

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币
  • Debt currency债务货币
  • Hedges对冲
  • Effective date生效日期
Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币
  • Debt currency债务货币
  • Hedges对冲
  • Effective date生效日期
Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币
  • Debt currency债务货币
  • Hedges对冲
  • Effective date生效日期
Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Fast pressure. Slow resilience.短期压力，长期韧性

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币
  • Debt currency债务货币
  • Hedges对冲
  • Effective date生效日期
Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

    MANUAL / CONDITIONAL手动 / 条件情景

    Test your assumptions检验您的假设

    Enter returns over the selected horizon. These assumptions are not forecasts and do not update source history.输入所选区间内的回报。这些假设不是预测，也不会更新来源历史。

    Manual return assumptions手动回报假设

    Use a decimal point, for example 1.5. A positive currency return means the local currency strengthens against USD.使用小数点，例如 1.5。汇率回报为正表示本币相对美元升值。

    Review assumptions for the proposed context检查拟用范围的假设

    Your original context and calculation are retained. Review the inputs above before confirming; no return is annualized.原范围和计算结果已保留。确认前请检查上方输入；不会将回报年化。

    Clear these two assumptions?清除这两个假设？

    Market, horizon, pins and research history will be preserved.市场、区间、固定项及研究历史将保留。

    Enter both assumptions, then calculate.输入两个假设后计算。

    Conditional USD return条件美元回报

    FX contribution汇率贡献:

    Over the confirmed horizon · price return · unhedged已确认区间内 · 价格回报 · 未对冲

    Illustrative FX assumptions示例汇率假设

      These rows are illustrations, not a likely range or an optimized outcome.这些仅为示例，并非可能范围或最优结果。

      Calculation method计算方法

      USD return = (1 + local return) × (1 + currency return) − 1. FX contribution = (1 + local return) × currency return. Percent inputs are divided by 100 before calculation.美元回报 = (1 + 本币回报) × (1 + 汇率回报) − 1。汇率贡献 = (1 + 本币回报) × 汇率回报。计算前将百分比输入除以 100。

      A return quoted in local currency per USD requires reciprocal conversion; changing its sign is not sufficient.每美元兑本币的反向报价回报必须按倒数换算，不能仅改变正负号。

      Contagion board传导看板 ?How tightly are global markets linked right now? The score (0–100) measures how far a shock in one market travels to others, using a rolling 150-day window. Higher = shocks spread faster. Top shock senders are markets that export the most stress to peers. US receiving share = how much of international stress eventually reaches the S&P 500 — this is a transmission read, not a causal share. Source: daily ETF returns.全球市场目前关联程度如何？得分（0–100）衡量某市场冲击向其他市场的传导程度，使用150日滚动窗口。数值越高，冲击传播越快。前三大冲击输出方是最多向同伴输出压力的市场。美国接收份额 = 国际压力最终传导至标普500的比例——这是传导读数，非因果占比。数据来源：ETF日度收益。
